series.name: 5P Gen2 (line-interactive UPS, tower and rack models 550-3000 VA class)
series.notes: Generation 2 of the 5P line-interactive family. No numeric A/F codes in the manual - named LCD conditions with LED colour/on-off and beeper cadence. Differences from gen-1 5P (SERIES 4): overload threshold is '>100% of nominal' here vs '>105%' in gen 1; 'End of battery life' is renamed 'Battery fault'; overtemperature now says the UPS 'shuts down' if temperature rises another 10 degrees C (gen 1 9PX wording says 'transfers to Bypass mode or shuts down if Bypass is unusable'); RPO is a separate named cause. Treat gen 1 and gen 2 as separate lookups.

title.ur: Battery mode (UPS battery par chal raha hai)

meaning.en: A utility failure has occurred and the UPS is in battery mode, powering the equipment from its batteries.
meaning.ur: Utility failure hua hai aur UPS battery mode mein hai, equipment ko apni batteries se power de raha hai.

causes.en: The utility supply has failed or is outside the transfer window.
causes.ur: Utility supply chala gaya hai ya transfer range se bahar hai.

causes.en: The user has deliberately selected battery mode from the panel.
causes.ur: User ne panel se jaanbujhkar battery mode select kiya hai.

solutions.en: Save your work and prepare your equipment for shutdown, because runtime is limited.
solutions.ur: Apna kaam bacha lein aur equipment ko shutdown ke liye tayyar karein, kyunke runtime mehdud hai.

solutions.en: Read the remaining runtime and battery level on the front panel display.
solutions.ur: Front panel display par baaqi runtime aur battery level parhein.

solutions.en: When mains returns, confirm the unit is back on mains and the battery is charging.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par confirm karein ke unit mains par wapas aa gaya hai aur battery charge ho rahi hai.

codes.blinkPattern: LED solid On, 1 beep every 10 seconds

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

title.ur: Battery low (runtime khatam hone wali hai)

meaning.en: The UPS is in battery mode and the battery is running low. The manual warns this can appear before 20% capacity.
meaning.ur: UPS battery mode mein hai aur battery low ho rahi hai. Manual kehti hai ke ye 20% capacity se pehle aa sakti hai.

causes.en: The outage has lasted long enough to reach the low-charge warning level.
causes.ur: Outage itni der rahi ke low-charge warning level aa gaya.

causes.en: The battery string is aged and holds less charge than rated.
causes.ur: Battery string purani hai aur rated se kam charge rakhti hai.

solutions.en: Shut down non-essential equipment now to stretch the remaining runtime.
solutions.ur: Baaqi runtime barhane ke liye abhi ghair zaroori equipment band kar dein.

solutions.en: Read the actual remaining runtime on the display; the manual warns the estimate varies with load and EBM count.
solutions.ur: Display par asal baaqi runtime parhein; manual kehti hai ke estimate load aur EBM tadaad ke saath badalti hai.

solutions.en: Once mains returns, give the UPS 48 hours of utility power to restore full charge.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par UPS ko poori charge ke liye 48 ghante utility power dein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED solid On, 1 beep every 3 seconds

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

meaning.en: The batteries are disconnected, so the UPS has no battery backup at all.
meaning.ur: Batteries disconnect hain, is liye UPS ka koi battery backup nahi hai.

causes.en: The internal battery connector is unplugged or not fully seated.
causes.ur: Internal battery connector nahi laga ya poori tarah seat nahi hua.

causes.en: An EBM power connector or its battery detection connector is unplugged.
causes.ur: EBM ka power connector ya us ka battery detection connector nahi laga hua.

causes.en: A battery harness pin is loose, corroded or broken.
causes.ur: Battery harness ka pin dhile, zang khaa ya toota hua hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug the mains and wait at least 5 minutes before opening the battery bay.
solutions.ur: UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein aur battery bay kholne se pehle kam az kam 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Verify that all batteries are properly connected; push every connector firmly until it clicks into place.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke saari batteries theek se juri hain; har connector ko click hone tak mazbooti se push karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery DC voltage with a DMM; if the condition persists, contact your service representative.
solutions.ur: DMM se battery DC voltage maarein; agar masla barqarar rahe to apne service representative se rabta karein.

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

title.ur: Battery fault (battery test fail ho gaya)

meaning.en: The battery test failed because of bad or disconnected batteries. On 5P Gen2 this row replaces the gen-1 wording 'End of battery life'.
meaning.ur: Battery test fail ho gaya kyunke batteries kharab ya disconnect hain. 5P Gen2 par is row ne gen-1 ke 'End of battery life' ki jagah li hai.

causes.en: The battery cells are dead, shorted, or the string is at end of life.
causes.ur: Battery cells mar chuke hain, short hain, ya string end of life par hai.

causes.en: A battery is disconnected, so the test fails before it can complete.
causes.ur: Koi battery disconnect hai, is liye test poora hone se pehle fail ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Verify that all batteries are properly connected, with the UPS off and mains unplugged.
solutions.ur: UPS band karke aur mains nikal kar check karein ke saari batteries theek se juri hain.

solutions.en: Measure each cell voltage with a DMM; replace the string as a set if the readings are unequal or low.
solutions.ur: DMM se har cell ka voltage maarein; readings barabar na hon ya kam hon to poori string set ke taur par replace karein.

solutions.en: If the condition persists after reconnection, contact your service representative for battery replacement.
solutions.ur: Dohasne ke baad bhi masla barqarar rahe to battery tabdeeli ke liye apne service representative se rabta karein.

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

codes.code: The UPS does not provide the expected backup time
aliases: The UPS does not provide the expected backup time

title.ur: Backup time itni kam hai jitni umeed thi nahi

meaning.en: The UPS does not give the rated runtime on discharge; the batteries need charging or service.
meaning.ur: UPS discharge par rated runtime nahi deta; batteries ko charging ya servicing chahiye.

causes.en: The batteries are not fully charged (new unit or long time unused).
causes.ur: Batteries poori tarah charge nahi hain (naya unit ya lambi der se istemal nahi).

causes.en: The battery string has aged and lost capacity.
causes.ur: Battery string purani ho chuki hai aur capacity khoyi hai.

causes.en: The connected load is higher than the rating used to calculate the expected runtime.
causes.ur: Connected load un rating se zyada hai jis se expected runtime nikala gaya tha.

solutions.en: Apply utility power for 48 hours to charge the batteries, then retest.
solutions.ur: Batteries charge karne ke liye 48 ghante utility power dein, phir dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Measure the actual output current with a clamp meter and compare with the manual's runtime table.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se asal output current maarein aur manual ke runtime table se tulna karein.

solutions.en: If runtime is still short after 48 hours of charging, contact your service representative.
solutions.ur: 48 ghante charging ke baad bhi runtime kam ho to apne service representative se rabta karein.

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

title.ur: Power Overload (load UPS capacity se zyada)

meaning.en: Power requirements exceed the UPS capacity (greater than 100% of nominal). The alarm resets by itself once the condition becomes inactive.
meaning.ur: Power requirements UPS capacity se zyada hain (nominal ke 100% se zyada). Shart hatne par alarm khud ba khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: More equipment is connected than the 5P Gen2 is rated for.
causes.ur: 5P Gen2 ki rating se zyada equipment lagaya gaya hai.

causes.en: A large inrush device such as an air conditioner or motor was switched on.
causes.ur: Koi bada inrush device jaise air conditioner ya motor on kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Remove some of the equipment from the UPS until the load percentage on the display is back under the limit.
solutions.ur: Display par load percentage limit ke andar aane tak UPS se kuch equipment nikaalte jayein.

solutions.en: Check the specific output overload ranges under "User Settings" for your model before deciding.
solutions.ur: Faisla karne se pehle apne model ke "User Settings" mein diye gaye khaas output overload ranges check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the alarm clears by itself; if it does not, disconnect the output and recheck the load with a clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke alarm khud clear ho jata hai; agar na ho to output disconnect karke clamp meter se dobara load check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED solid On (manual does not state a beeper cadence for this row)

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

meaning.en: The internal temperature is too high or a fan has failed. At warning level the UPS stays in its current state; another 10 degrees C rise shuts it down.
meaning.ur: Andar ka temperature bohat zyada hai ya fan kharab ho gaya hai. Warning level par UPS apni halaat mein rehta hai; 10 degree C aur izafa hone par band ho jata hai.

causes.en: A fan has failed and heat is building inside the unit.
causes.ur: Fan kharab ho gaya hai aur unit ke andar garmi jama ho rahi hai.

causes.en: Vents are blocked or airflow around the unit is restricted.
causes.ur: Vents band hain ya unit ke gird ka airflow band hai.

causes.en: The surrounding temperature is above the model's operating range (0 to 40 degrees C).
causes.ur: Gird ka temperature model ke operating range (0 se 40 degree C) se zyada hai.

solutions.en: Clear vents and remove any heat sources. Allow the UPS to cool.
solutions.ur: Vents saaf karein aur heat source hata dein. UPS ko thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: Ensure the airflow around the UPS is not restricted; keep at least the manual's clearance on all sides.
solutions.ur: UPS ke gird ka airflow band na ho; har taraf manual ki clearance rakhein.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature with a thermometer; if it is above 40 degrees C, fix the room cooling first, then check the fan.
solutions.ur: Thermometer se ambient temperature maarein; 40 degree C se zyada ho to pehle room cooling theek karein, phir fan check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED solid On, 1 beep every 3 seconds

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

codes.code: The UPS does not start (input source not connected correctly)
aliases: The UPS does not start (input source not connected correctly)

title.en: UPS does not start - input not connected
title.ur: UPS start nahi ho raha - input connect nahi

meaning.en: The input source is not connected correctly, so the UPS will not start.
meaning.ur: Input source theek se connect nahi hai, is liye UPS start nahi hota.

causes.en: The mains input cable is loose or not fully pushed into the inlet.
causes.ur: Mains input cable dhili hai ya inlet mein poori tarah nahi lagi.

causes.en: The input breaker or the input protection fuse has tripped.
causes.ur: Input breaker ya input protection fuse trip ho chuka hai.

causes.en: The battery connection is also open, so the unit refuses to start.
causes.ur: Battery connection bhi khuli hai, is liye unit start karne se inkaar karta hai.

solutions.en: Check the input and battery connections as the manual directs, with the UPS switched off.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq UPS band karte hue input aur battery connections check karein.

solutions.en: Measure mains voltage at the input inlet with a DMM and confirm the input breaker is closed.
solutions.ur: DMM se input inlet par mains voltage maarein aur confirm karein ke input breaker band hai.

solutions.en: Reseat the battery connector firmly, then retry the start from the front panel.
solutions.ur: Battery connector ko mazbooti se dobara baitha dein, phir front panel se dobara start karein.

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

codes.code: The UPS does not start (RPO active / connector missing)
aliases: The UPS does not start (RPO active / connector missing)

title.en: UPS does not start - RPO active
title.ur: UPS start nahi ho raha - RPO active hai

meaning.en: The Remote Power Off switch is active or the RPO connector is missing, which is preventing restart.
meaning.ur: Remote Power Off switch active hai ya RPO connector missing hai, jis ki wajah se restart nahi ho raha.

causes.en: The RPO wall switch or contact has been pressed/closed.
causes.ur: RPO wall switch ya contact press/band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: The RPO connector is not plugged into its terminal at all.
causes.ur: RPO connector apne terminal par lagaya hi nahi gaya.

causes.en: A building/fire-alarm contact wired to RPO has closed.
causes.ur: RPO se juri building/fire-alarm contact band ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: If the UPS Status menu displays the "Remote Power Off" notice, deactivate the RPO input.
solutions.ur: Agar UPS Status menu par "Remote Power Off" ka notice aaye to RPO input deactivate karein.

solutions.en: Measure the RPO terminal pair with a DMM; it must be open for the unit to be allowed to run.
solutions.ur: DMM se RPO terminal pair check karein; unit ko chalne dene ke liye ye open hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Find out why RPO was activated before you clear it, then restart from the front panel.
solutions.ur: Clear karne se pehle dekhein ke RPO kyun activate hua, phir front panel se restart karein.

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)
